name: FormFlow Self-Hosted Forms
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted conversational form and survey builder with conditional logic, response analytics, CSV/JSON export and SQLite storage; no vendor-imposed per-response fee, software subscription or expiry.
watch_out: Free software only; Docker/server, storage, backups, TLS and outbound connectivity are self-managed and may cost money. Default public write rate limit is 120 requests/IP/minute and upload limit is 10 MB, both configurable. New project with limited adoption; secure first administrator registration before exposing publicly.
